Inspected restart coverage exercises real Gateway lifecycle and SQLite settlement with controlled agent execution; reported test totals were not independently rerun. | | **Evidence reviewed** | 9 items | Current main still contains the defect: Fetched main still classifies announcement-origin turns as disposable completion reports, allowing unfinished parent work to be reconciled without continuation.
Latest supplied release retains the same shortcut: The v2026.9.5 source also contains completionSource-based reconciliation; the central repair is not already supplied by that release.
Recovery ownership and final effects: Child recovery captures session identity, checks live executions and admission, and passes current-owner predicates into terminal completion. Completion rechecks after acquiring its lock; cleanup persists suppression when ownership changes while saved-result delivery remains independent. | | **Findings** | None | None. | | **Security** | None | None. | ## How this fits together Gateway restart recovery reads persisted conversations and delegated-task records to determine what work remains.
